name: Quarrel
description: A dark, dense changelog of typed rows: a grid-line hero, releases grouped under collapsible month headings, a mono date and an upper-case type label on every row, and a checkbox panel to narrow by type and tag.
features: Index layout: rows (one ruled line per release)
Upper-case, outlined change-type labels in mono (Release, Improvement, Security, Retired)
Filter panel: types, tags, Breaking, Any/All
Copy-the-feed and social links on the title row
Release page: centred, on-this-page outline, reading time, prev/next
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

attrs.heading: Get the changelog
attrs.body: New releases, improvements and retirements in one weekly email.

posts.title: Merge queue is generally available
posts.markdown:
Merge queue keeps your default branch green by testing every pull request against the changes queued ahead of it. After a public preview, it is available to every organization.

## Added

![The merge queue with three pull requests waiting](/api/assets/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000104)

- Queue rules per branch: build concurrency, minimum group size and a timeout.
- Jump the queue for a hotfix, with a reason recorded in the audit log.

## Fixed

- A pull request removed from the queue now re-runs its checks only once.

Placeholder release notes.

posts.title: Required reviewers per path
posts.markdown:
Rulesets can now require a reviewer from a named team for changes under a path, so the people who own a directory see every change to it.

## Changed

- `CODEOWNERS` is still honoured; a ruleset adds to it, never replaces it.
- The rule appears in the pull request's merge box with the team it is waiting for.

Placeholder release notes.

posts.title: Faster log search in workflow runs
posts.markdown:
Searching a workflow run's logs now returns matches across every step at once, and jumps straight to the line.

## Fixed

- Searching a run with more than 10,000 lines no longer times out.
- Collapsed groups expand when they contain a match.

Placeholder release notes.

posts.title: Secret scanning for private keys in commits
posts.markdown:
Pushes that contain a private key are now blocked by default for new repositories, with a one-click bypass that records who made it and why.

## Security

- Detects RSA, EC and Ed25519 keys in every supported encoding.
- Organization owners can turn the block on for existing repositories in one step.

Placeholder release notes.

posts.title: Classic deploy keys are retired
posts.markdown:
Classic deploy keys stop working on the date below. Fine-grained deploy keys replace them, scoped to a single repository and an expiry.

## Upgrading

Replace each classic key with a fine-grained one before the cut-off. Pipelines that still use a classic key will fail to clone with `403`. The settings page lists every classic key that is still in use, with its last use.

## Removed

- Creating classic deploy keys, in the settings and through the API.

Placeholder release notes.
